name: Oomura
source: Oomura-sensei is the homeroom teacher of [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s and [url=https://vndb.org/c8380]Asuka[/url]'s class. She also acts as a student's club adviser for [url=https://vndb.org/c33934]Miyuki[/url]'s drama club. She is a new teacher that came as a substitute for the old teacher, [url=https://vndb.org/c63617]Miyamura Hiroshi[/url]. Her mellow and approachable type of personality will come in handy once Takuya transforms into [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]a girl[/url] again this year.
